name: empty-state
description: Placeholder display for empty content areas with icon, message, and action

changes.note: BREAKING: the action cluster is one slot. data-part="action" and data-part="secondary-action" — two slots the 1.x sheet styled and the 1.x manifest declared — are replaced by the single data-part="actions" cluster the reference now authors (task 0.9-04 moved the markup, 1.0R-07 moved the styling, and this entry records the vocabulary change neither of them wrote down). Migration: wrap the buttons in one <div data-part="actions"> instead of marking each one; the cluster wraps and centres, which is what stopped the two-button row bleeding past both phone edges. Also corrected here: data-size="md" and data-size="lg" are declared again. Both are styled by empty-state.css and both were legal in 1.x, but the manifest had been trimmed to sm alone, so faqir audit rejected markup the stylesheet renders — md is the unstyled default, lg is the larger cluster.
